items.title: 完成第二轮三 Host 可执行性复查
items.context: 使用两个 Claude CLI 分析和一个 Codex CLI host 分析复查当前 Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md，重点检查可执行性、host-neutral 边界、是否有任意优化，以及 memory baseline/scoring/1M recall 是否属于真实缺口。
items.userSees: "Second host review: Claude-A / Claude-B / Codex artifacts summarize whether the document is executable and whether baseline/scoring/1M recall is a real gap."

happy.desc: 三 Host 复查 artifact 分别给出 Claude-A、Claude-B、Codex 对当前文档可执行性和 baseline/scoring 缺口的判断。

edge.desc: 若某 host 认为 baseline 属于过度优化，最终 synthesis 必须说明为何采纳或排除，并保留不确定边界。

adversarial.desc: Host 输出不能直接变成 Lattice truth 或 gate evidence；文档采纳必须经过 host-neutral authority-preserving synthesis。

verificationEvidence.command: omx ask claude <architecture prompt>; omx ask claude <skeptical prompt>; codex exec -C . -s read-only -o .omx/artifacts/lifecycle-memory-baseline-codex-B-ec81.md <review prompt>
verificationEvidence.note: Three host review completed. Artifacts: .omx/artifacts/lifecycle-memory-baseline-claude-a-B-ec81.md, .omx/artifacts/lifecycle-memory-baseline-claude-b-B-ec81.md, .omx/artifacts/lifecycle-memory-baseline-codex-B-ec81.md. All three reviewed document executability, host-neutral boundaries, and baseline/scoring/1M recall scope.

Disagreement resolved conservatively: baseline/scoring is accepted only as a future validation contract and boundary-integrity scoring; 1M recall is stress-tier only, not v0 hard implementation or arbitrary advisory-memory quality optimization.

verificationEvidence.command: git check-ignore -v .omx/artifacts/lifecycle-memory-baseline-*-B-ec81.md; koala checklist_update CHK-001 files create empty
verificationEvidence.note: Host outputs remain local manual review evidence, not committed deliverables or Lattice truth. Checklist file declarations were narrowed so ignored .omx transcripts are not mistaken for gate artifacts; synthesis must be applied through the document itself.

items.title: 补齐 memory baseline 与评分机制方案
items.context: 若三 Host 复查确认 baseline 缺失是执行方案的真实 correctness gap，则只更新 Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md，加入基线数据集、评分指标、100 万数据召回压测、阈值、失败分类和不做项；不实现存储或召回引擎。
items.userSees: "Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md includes a baseline/scoring/1M recall contract without adding storage/provider implementation."

happy.desc: 文档新增 memory baseline/scoring/1M recall section，包含 corpus、query set、metrics、thresholds、failure taxonomy 和资源记录。

edge.desc: 1M recall 方案必须可作为 future story 的执行契约，但不得承诺当前已实现 memory harness 或具体 backend。

adversarial.desc: 新增 baseline 不能引入 SQLite/vector DB/external provider、auto skill replay、auto-DONE 或 production authority 扩张。

verificationEvidence.note: Document now contains the future Memory Recall Validation Contract with corpus/data sources, excluded sources, query families, contract scoring, tiers including 1,000,000 candidates, authority boundary terms, and non-goals.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "future implementation prerequisite|stress-only|not current|Koala REVIEW / TEST / DONE gate evidence|storage engine|benchmark runner|vector DB|SQLite/DuckDB|external provider|embedding model" Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md
verificationEvidence.note: 1,000,000 candidates are documented as stress-only future validation, not a current harness, current implementation, backend selection, or production guarantee.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "productionDone:true|gateEvidence:true|Gate meaning|hard gate" Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md || true; git diff --check -- Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md
verificationEvidence.note: No positive productionDone:true or gateEvidence:true wording remains; gate-like wording was reduced to contract-level checks. diff check passed after commit 0428b81f.

items.title: 验证文档可执行且不越权
items.context: 用 docs_check/cli/manual transcript 证明最终文档包含可执行 baseline/scoring/1M recall 测试路径，并保持 dev-memory 与 host transcript 的 advisory boundary，不把 benchmark 或 host 输出变成 gate evidence。
items.userSees: "Validation confirms the updated document is executable, benchmark-focused, and keeps memory/host outputs non-authoritative."

happy.desc: docs_check 命令能定位 baseline/scoring/1M recall、阈值、测试矩阵和非目标关键词。

edge.desc: 验证路径必须说明 benchmark PASS 只是 future implementation validation，不能替代 Koala validation evidence、review pass、delivery check 或 receipt。

adversarial.desc: 最终 validate 与 reviewer 检查必须确认文档没有把 dev-memory、host transcript 或 benchmark score 当成 gate evidence。

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Memory Recall Validation Contract|Corpus / data sources|Excluded sources|Query set|Scoring and thresholds|T3|1,000,000 candidates|Failure taxonomy|Contract boundary" Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md
verificationEvidence.note: Required baseline/scoring/1M recall contract sections and terms are present and discoverable in the final document.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "B-f1d3|historical v0 review input|koala validate --story=<current-story>|输出当前 story" Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md; git show --check --stat --oneline 0428b81f -- Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md
verificationEvidence.note: Historical B-f1d3 artifact references are labeled as historical v0 review input; current validation is generalized to <current-story>. The committed document patch has no whitespace/check errors.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "productionDone:true|gateEvidence:true|Gate meaning|hard gate|review_pass_set.*benchmark|koala validate evidence.*benchmark" Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md || true
verificationEvidence.note: No positive productionDone:true/gateEvidence:true or benchmark-to-gate wording remains. Benchmark PASS is documented only as a future contract result, not Koala gate evidence, review pass, delivery check, receipt, or production authority.
